text:
maria: Hey folks — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8341 that changes how we emit audit events for secret access in Private deploys. It also adds a small secrets-redaction helper to the logging pipeline. Would appreciate quick eyes; need security sign-off before merging. CI is failing one unit test right now.

sam: taking a look now. Quick skim — looks small. Main question: are we changing any persisted schema for audit events?

maria: No schema change, just adding an "enriched_event" wrapper with masked payloads. Example log emitted: ```{"event":"secret.read","user":"svc-agent","payload":"[REDACTED]","request_id":"r-123"}``` — we intentionally strip raw values.

security-eng: Heads up — for compliance we need an explicit note in the PR describing the redaction algorithm and the threat model (how we prevent accidental full secret writes to logs). Also confirm key rotation behavior if HSM signing is used.

maria: will add a short docblurb in the PR and a unit test for the redaction function. On HSM: this PR doesn't change signing; HSM integration happens in a follow-up. I'll call that out.

devops-bot: CI pipeline status: build failed — tests/unit/logging_test.py::test_mask_secret_output (flaky: false).

ali: I can fix the failing test — the test expects the old log shape. I'll update assertions to match the wrapper. Quick note: we need two approvers for auth/audit changes per policy. tagging @leah for second approval.

leah: Thanks @ali — I'll review after the doc note is added. Small suggestion: include an example of the raw -> redacted transform in the PR description. Saves back-and-forth. :thumbsup:

sam: LGTM on code side aside from one nit about renaming mask_secret -> redact_secret to be explicit. left an inline comment.

maria: pushed test fix and added the docblurb + raw->redacted example. Updated function name per sam's comment. CI rerunning.

devops-bot: CI pipeline status: all checks passed. Merge blocked: policy requires security signoff + 2 approvers for files under /security and /audit.

security-eng: Approved for policy compliance — docblurb looks good and threat model note added. One operational ask: add a short rollout note in the PR describing how we will monitor for any increase in 5xxs after deploy (console alert + short eval prompt).

leah: Approving now.

ali: Approving and will watch post-deploy metrics.

maria: Thanks everyone — merging will wait until tomorrow morning release window. I'll also add the rollout monitoring playbook link before merge. Appreciated :heart:

sam: Nice — thanks for handling the follow-ups.

maria: (follow-up) PR merged in next-day release window and deployment started. Will post an incident thread if anything odd shows up.
